column4: function reducer(state, action) { switch(action.type) { case 'INCREMENT': return { count: state.count + 1 }; } }

column2: Paano gamitin ang useReducer sa component?
column4: const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, { count: 0 }); dispatch({ type: 'INCREMENT' });

column2: Paano mag-add ng logging sa reducer?
column4: function loggingReducer(state, action) { console.log(action); return reducer(state, action); }
I-test ang pure function: expect(reducer(initialState, {type: 'ADD'})).toEqual(expectedState); — walang mocks needed

column2: Paano i-combine ang useReducer at Context?
column4: <AppContext.Provider value={{ state, dispatch }}> — i-provide ang state at dispatch sa Context
